title: Full of Grace
synopsis: In Dover, New Hampshire, eleven-year-old Holly Roberts vanishes from the woods, leaving behind only her hobbyhorse. Detective John Kierstead, a troubled LA cop, returns home for his father Mackie's funeral and is pulled into the investigation alongside Doug, his sister Trudy's boyfriend on the force. John uncovers that Mackie and family friend Reggie had been violently pursuing a suspect called El Vaquero, torturing an innocent man. Reggie is killed confronting John at the family cabin. Authorities arrest Raymond Olsen, a disabled man, for Holly's murder. John discovers Trudy's car at a church and finds her in a confessional: she admits she arranged Holly's abduction to punish Holly's mother Cheyenne, then drowned Holly during a makeshift baptism ritual when the girl resisted. John gives Trudy his keys and lets her drive off, choosing silence over turning her in. He then arrives at the door of his late friend Andy's parents, preparing to finally confess the truth about Andy's death twenty years earlier.
